Categorical Eligibility (CE) eliminates resource requirements, the gross income test, and net income test for assistance units with countable income up to 200% of the federal poverty guidelines.

## Income Thresholds

For 2026, 200% FPL equals $31,920/year for a household of 1 and $66,000/year for a household of 4.

The 200% FPL standard is a common eligibility threshold used to expand food assistance access while waiving resource/asset requirements for qualifying households.
